# MyyShop

> MyyShop is an AI-driven global creator marketing platform that empowers creators to monetize their influence and grow their earnings through paid collaborations, free samples, and cash payouts.

Canonical Origin: https://www.myyshop.com

## LLM Resources

- [Full Content](https://www.myyshop.com/llms-full.txt) Complete site content in markdown format for comprehensive understanding.
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.myyshop.com/sitemap_index.xml) XML sitemap for search engines and crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://www.myyshop.com/robots.txt) Crawler rules and permissions.

## Platform Overview

MyyShop is a social commerce platform that enables creators, influencers, and content producers to:
- Earn from brand collaborations with 100% paid opportunities
- Receive free product samples for content creation
- Get 100% cash payouts with transparent earnings
- Build personalized storefronts (Bio pages) with AI assistance
- Access thousands of products to sell on social media effortlessly
- Connect with global brands through AI-powered matching

## Key Features

### Creator Tools
- **Bio Pages**: Personalized storefronts with custom domains and branding
- **Product Discovery**: AI-powered product recommendations based on niche and audience
- **Content Creation**: Free samples and brand-sponsored opportunities
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Real-time performance tracking and insights
- **Wallet System**: Transparent earnings tracking and instant cash withdrawals

### AI-Powered Services
- **MyyCompass**: AI agent for niche discovery and audience insights
- **Smart Recommendations**: AI-driven product and opportunity matching
- **Content Optimization**: AI-assisted bio and product descriptions

### Business Models
- **Affiliate Marketing**: Earn commission from every order generated
- **Brand Collaborations**: Paid partnerships with global brands
- **Referral Program**: Earn by inviting other creators

## Core Pages

### Public Pages
- [Home](https://www.myyshop.com/): Platform overview, features, and creator success stories. Start earning with MyyShop.
- [About Us](https://www.myyshop.com/about-us): Learn about MyyShop's mission to empower creators through AI-driven monetization tools.
- [For Creators](https://www.myyshop.com/for-creators): Landing page for creators to join the MyyShop network, review benefits, FAQs, and contact details.
- [For Brands](https://www.myyshop.com/for-brands): Landing page for brands exploring TikTok Shop management, creator campaigns, livestream commerce, and contact options.
- [Brand Deals & Opportunities](https://www.myyshop.com/brand-deals-opportunies): Discover how creators can access brand collaboration opportunities.
- [Earn from Every View - MyyFinds](https://www.myyshop.com/earn-from-every-view-myyfinds): MyyFinds program for creators to earn from social content engagement.

### Documentation
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.myyshop.com/docs/privacy): Privacy policy and data protection information.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.myyshop.com/docs/termsCondition): Platform terms of service and usage guidelines.

### Authentication
- [Login](https://www.myyshop.com/login): Sign in to creator dashboard.
- [Register](https://www.myyshop.com/register): Join MyyShop as a creator or brand.

### Creator Dashboard (Authentication Required)
- [Creator Home](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/home): Creator dashboard with performance overview, earnings, and recommendations.
- [Opportunities](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/opportunities): Browse and apply for brand collaboration opportunities.
- [Offers](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/offers): Manage active brand deals and track progress.
- [Profile Settings](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/profile): Update creator profile, social accounts, and payment information.
- [Wallet](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/wallet): View earnings, transaction history, and request withdrawals.
- [Refer & Earn](https://www.myyshop.com/admin/refer/earn): Invite creators and earn referral rewards.

### Bio Storefront System
- [Create Bio Page](https://www.myyshop.com/shop/create): Set up your personalized creator storefront.
- [Bio Admin](https://www.myyshop.com/shop/admin): Manage your Bio page content, products, and appearance.
- [Product Selection](https://www.myyshop.com/shop/products): Browse and add products to your storefront.
- [Bio Preview](https://www.myyshop.com/shop/preview): Preview your Bio page before publishing.
- [Bio Insights](https://www.myyshop.com/shop/insight): Analytics for Bio page performance and visitor engagement.
  - [Bio Pages](https://myyfinds.io/[bioname]): Public creator storefronts (replace [bioname] with creator username).

### AI Agent Services
- [MyyCompass Chat](https://www.myyshop.com/chat): AI-powered assistant for niche discovery and creator guidance.
- [AI Chatbot](https://www.myyshop.com/agent/chatbot): Interactive AI agent for creator support and insights.

### Blog & Content
- [Blog Home](https://www.myyshop.com/blog): Creator stories, tips, and platform updates.
- [Blog Articles](https://www.myyshop.com/blog/[blogName]): Individual blog posts (replace [blogName] with article slug).

### Campaign Pages
- [MyyFinds Introduction](https://www.myyshop.com/myyfinds-introduction): Learn about the MyyFinds creator program.
- [MyyFinds Win the Cash](https://www.myyshop.com/myyfinds-win-the-cash): Participate in cash reward campaigns.
- [Quick Tasks Earn Cash](https://www.myyshop.com/campaign/quick-tasks-earn-cash): Complete tasks for instant cash rewards.
- [Season Prize Campaign](https://www.myyshop.com/campaign/season-prize): Seasonal creator contests and prizes.
- [MyyFinds Task Hub](https://www.myyshop.com/campaign/myyfinds-task): Task-based earning opportunities for creators.

### MCN & Partnership
- [MCN Affiliate Program](https://www.myyshop.com/mcnaffiliate): Multi-channel network partnership opportunities.

### Reports & Analytics (Authentication Required)
- [Report Center](https://www.myyshop.com/report): Business intelligence and performance reports.
- [Report Details](https://www.myyshop.com/report/detail/[id]): Detailed analytics reports (authentication required).

## Target Audience

### Primary Users
- **Content Creators**: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other social media influencers
- **Micro-Influencers**: Creators with 1K-100K followers looking to monetize
- **Nano-Influencers**: Emerging creators starting their monetization journey
- **Brands**: Companies seeking authentic creator partnerships
- **MCN Agencies**: Talent management and creator networks

### Geographic Focus
- Global platform with primary markets in North America, Europe, and Asia
- Multi-language support through i18n
- Localized content and opportunities

## Business Value Propositions

### For Creators
- **Zero Cost Entry**: Free to join, no subscription fees
- **100% Paid Opportunities**: All collaborations are compensated
- **Free Product Samples**: Receive products for authentic reviews
- **100% Cash Payouts**: Transparent earnings with no hidden fees
- **AI-Powered Matching**: Smart opportunity recommendations
- **Flexible Monetization**: Multiple earning streams (affiliate, brand deals, referrals)

### For Brands
- **Authentic Reach**: Connect with genuine creator audiences
- **Performance-Based**: Pay for actual results and engagement
- **Global Network**: Access creators worldwide
- **AI Matching**: Find creators aligned with brand values
- **Transparent Metrics**: Real-time campaign performance tracking

## Technical Stack

- **Framework**: Nuxt 3 (Vue 3 + SSR)
- **UI Libraries**: Element Plus (Desktop), Vant (Mobile)
- **CSS**: UnoCSS, Tailwind CSS, SCSS
- **State Management**: Pinia
- **i18n**: @nuxtjs/i18n for multilingual support
- **SEO**: @nuxtjs/sitemap, Schema.org structured data
- **Monitoring**: Sentry error tracking
- **AI Integration**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) compatible

## SEO & Discovery

### Structured Data
- Organization Schema for platform identity
- Article Schema for blog content
- Product Schema for featured items
- Person Schema for creator Bio pages
- Review Schema for testimonials

### Search Optimization
- Dynamic sitemap generation for blogs and Bio pages
- Optimized meta tags for all public pages
- Open Graph tags for social sharing
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Fast page load with Nuxt SSR
